subject: Private/VPC deployment — licensing model options & unit-price synthesis
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@medsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Private/VPC deployment — licensing model options & unit-price synthesis

Alex — great to meet today. Quick recap and next steps from our side so procurement has a single doc to work against.

Call highlights (30m):
- Target workload: 200M tokens/month steady state, with 3x spike windows during month-end processing.
- Primary requirement: private VPC deployment (no shared-hosted data plane), encryption-at-rest w/ customer KMS, 2 isolated environments (prod + pre-prod).
- SLA ask: 99.9% uptime and 100ms median generation latency under baseline load.
- Security: SOC 2 + evidence bundle required; procurement will run a questionnaire.

Pricing items you asked us to confirm:
1) Licensing model: perpetual-style platform license vs. annual subscription — we proposed an annual capacity license with optional multi-year discount.
2) Unit economics anchor: our hosted equivalent often targets $900–1,200 per 1M tokens for production-grade private deployments; with dedicated capacity and multi-year commit we can typically improve to $450–700 per 1M tokens depending on environment count and support tier.
3) Environment multiplier: additional isolated envs are priced as a % of base license (prod = 100%, pre-prod = 20–30% of prod license for compute reservation).
4) Support tiers: Standard (business hours) / Premium (24x7, 1-hour P1) / Enterprise (dedicated TAM + quarterly on-site). Premium and Enterprise add known uplift to both unit charge and license fee.

Requested next steps (for procurement):
- I will send a consolidated pricing sheet with two scenarios: (A) conservative: 200M tokens/month, 2 envs, Premium support; (B) committed: 200M tokens/month with 24-month commit, 3 envs, Enterprise support.
- Alex: confirm budget range and whether the token count is a forecast baseline vs. a guaranteed commit. Procurement indicated a target budget band of $75k–$150k/month but we need confirmation if that’s OPEX-only.
- MedSys: procurement to share any required contract clauses (data residency, indemnity, export controls) — we’ll pre-populate where possible.

Attachments: pricing sheet stub attached for internal reference.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@medsys.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medsys.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private/VPC deployment — licensing model options & unit-price synthesis

Vivek — thanks for the clear summary. Couple of clarifications from procurement side:

- That $75k–$150k/month band is our initial internal target for the whole program (OPEX + any annualized platform fee). We have executive latitude up to $200k/month for year-one if outcomes are good.
- The 200M tokens/month is an expected steady-state for year-one; we can commit to a 12-month minimum, with an option to convert to a 24-month commit if we see token growth.
- Environments: we definitely need Prod and Pre-Prod. A third sandbox environment may be optional; please price it but flag it as optional for the purchase order.
- Security: procurement will send the SOC 2 questionnaire and a short list of contract clauses tomorrow.

We look forward to seeing the two scenario sheets. Also: can you provide a simple per-1M-token table that maps to the support tier and whether a multi-year commit discount is applied? Procurement wants a straightforward number they can plug into their financial model.

— Alex
Sr. Product Ops, MedSys Health
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Private/VPC deployment — pricing follow-up (MedSys) — internal pricing synthesis

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Alex's reply. Procurement gave a rough $75k–$150k/mo band and signaled flexibility to $200k/mo Y1. They can commit 12 months guaranteed; 24 months is optional. Key asks: per-1M-token table by support tier + explicit line for optional 3rd env.

I sketched two scenarios and assumptions below (please verify math and produce final numbers in the attached pricing sheet):

Assumptions common to both scenarios:
- Baseline model: G4-equivalent hosting with KV-cache enabled, expected average token length 75 tokens/request, payload distribution yields effective cost factor of 1.1x baseline per-token.
- Overheads: network egress, enterprise support, and audit evidence packaging are line items.

Scenario A (No multi-year commit):
- 200M tokens/month, 2 envs (prod + pre-prod), Premium support
- License: annual subscription = $X base platform fee (TBD) + compute/usage unit at $1,050 per 1M tokens
- Optional 3rd env add: +25% of prod license (config as "sandbox optional")

Scenario B (24-month committed):
- 200M tokens/month, 3 envs, Enterprise support, 24-month commit
- License: multi-year discounted license + unit at $600 per 1M tokens (reflects reserve commit & dedicated capacity)
- Enterprise support uplift: +15% on license and per-1M rate

Deliverable for procurement: a single page per-scenario with: total monthly cost, annualized cost, per-1M token rate, delta vs. baseline. Also include clear bullets on what is included/excluded.

Can you validate the $1,050 and $600 anchors? If not, propose adjusted anchors and any contract language that should be pre-emptively surfaced. I’ll attach the completed sheet to the next outbound.

— Vivek
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Private/VPC deployment — pricing follow-up (MedSys) — internal pricing synthesis

Got it. Quick notes:

- Anchors look reasonable as starting points; propose we refine to: No-commit unit = $1,100 / 1M tokens (includes Premium support line item), 24m commit = $575 / 1M tokens with Enterprise support included (we'll present both with and without support uplift so procurement can see tails).
- Environment pricing: prod = 100%, pre-prod = 25% of prod license, sandbox optional = 15% (call out that sandbox is billed for reserved capacity not for ephemeral dev clusters).
- Add a short clause in the sheet: "Commit adjustment" that defines how under/over usage is reconciled monthly (true-up vs overage rate). Recommend true-up quarterly with month-to-month overage at 1.5x committed per-1M rate.
- Attach the updated pricing_sheet (Redwood_Private_Pricing_Sheet_v2.pdf) and a simple XLS with tabbed scenarios. I’ll draft the one-page scenario snapshots and send to Alex by EOD.

Next actions:
1) Marissa to produce one-pagers for Scenario A/B and per-1M token table by support tier.
2) Vivek to include optional procurement clauses (data residency, KMS, indemnity) in the final doc.
3) Ben to run a quick capacity check with infra (confirm that 200M steady + 3x spikes fits a single dedicated pool or whether we need burst capacity).

— Marissa
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
